 THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 07.05.2024 PASSED IN MVC NO.878/2019 ON THE FILE OF THE ADDITIONAL DISTRICT JUDGE AND ADDITIONAL MACT, UDUPI (SITTING AT KUNDAPURA), PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
 THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR HEARING THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE P SREE SUDHA
ORAL JUDGMENT

This appeal is filed by the appellant/claimant under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 challenging the judgment and award dated 07.05.2024 passed in MVC NO.878/2019 on the file of the Additional District Judge and Additional MACT, Udupi for enhancing the compensation.
NC: 2026:KHC:13837 HC-KAR 2.
Heard the arguments of the learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for respondent No.3.
The ranks of the parties are retained as per tribunal for the sake of convenience.
3. One Manikanta, son of Venkatesh met with an accident on 28.01.2019 and died subsequently.
His parents filed claim petition claiming compensation of Rs.35,00,000/-.
The Tribunal considering the entire evidence on record granted amount of Rs.23,01,309/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realisation.

Mr Venkatesh vs Mr Naveen on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116517315/
2 4.

Aggrieved by the said award they preferred an appeal and mainly contended that Manikantan was working as a granite cutter and earning Rs.17,228/- per month and 1/3rd is to be deducted towards personal expenses.
Also under the conventional heads the amount granted is meager therefore requested for enhancement of compensation.

Further submits that he incurred Rs.3,53,685/-
towards medical expenses.
The Tribunal NC: 2026:KHC:13837 HC-KAR committed error in deducting 1/3rd towards personal expense and the amount awarded towards consortium is only Rs.44,000/-.
Thus, requested for enhancement of the compensation.
5. It is submitted that Manikandan met with an accident on 28.01.2019 and his parents have not filed any proof of income.

As he met with an accident in the year 2019, his notional income is to be taken as Rs.14,000/- per month and he was aged 17 years at the time of the accident, therefore '18'
multiplier is applicable for him and he is entitled for 40% towards future prospects.
He was a bachelor therefore 50% is to be deducted towards his personal expenses.
Loss of dependency comes to Rs.14,000 + 40% x 12 x 18 - 50% = Rs.21,16,800.
Further, the petitioners are entitled for an amount of Rs.40,000/- by each of them towards filialia consortium and they are also entitled for Rs.30,000/- under the conventional heads.
The tribunal further granted an NC: 2026:KHC:13837 HC-KAR amount of Rs.3,53,685/- towards medical expenses and the same holds good.

6. Thus in all, components awarded by this court are as below, Particulars Amount Sl.Nos.
in Rs.
 1 Towards loss of dependency 21,16,800  2 Consortium 80,000  3 Conventional heads 30,000  4 Medical expenses 3,53,685  Total 25,80,485

Hence, the compensation granted by tribunal is enhanced from Rs.23,01,309/- to Rs.25,80,485/-
along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a.
7.

In the result, the following order is passed:
ORDER i.
Appeal is allowed in part.
NC: 2026:KHC:13837 HC-KAR ii.
The judgment and award dated 07.05.2024 passed in MVC NO.878/2019 on the file of the Additional District Judge and Additional MACT, Udupi, is modified.
iii. The claimants are entitled to a sum of Rs.25,80,485 /- along with interest at 6% p.a., from the date of petition till the date of realization, instead of Rs.23,01,309/- granted by the tribunal.

3 iv.
Respondent/Insurance Company has already deposited the awarded amount before the tribunal.
Therefore, respondent/Insurance Company is directed to deposit the enhanced compensation of Rs.2,79,176/- along with the interest at the rate of 6% within one month from the date of this order.
NC: 2026:KHC:13837 HC-KAR v.
On such deposit, petitioners are permitted to withdraw the entire amount along with interest accrued on the same.
